name: English
title: Chrome IT support
purpose: This tool lets IT support inspect a Chrome browser on your PC while you are assisting them. Start it only when you requested support.
steps: Download the Windows agent below and run it. It opens a separate Chrome window for support. Leave the console window open until support is finished, then close it.
warning: An existing Chrome window may expose open tabs, browsing activity and signed-in sessions to the support operator. Use that option only if you understand and agree.
existing: If IT asks to use an existing Chrome window, open chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging in that window. Copy its 127.0.0.1:PORT address and paste it into the agent console, then press Enter.
operator: IT operators sign in with their approved AD account, register their own SSH public key, and use the SSH command on the sessions page. Close the tunnel when support ends.
emailIntro: You have been invited to start a Chrome IT support session. Read {{helpUrl}}, then download and run the Windows agent: {{downloadUrl}}. Leave its console open until support is finished.
emailExisting: IT also asks you to connect your existing Chrome. Open chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging there and paste its 127.0.0.1:PORT into the agent console. Warning: this may expose open tabs and signed-in sessions.
